visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with a soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no scene props. The scene reads as a calm stylized diorama - simplified, clean shapes with a restrained warm-paper and muted-green palette, not cartoon, not cluttered. COLOR IS RESTRAINED: each subject is a muted near-paper shade; strong saturated color is reserved entirely for the small flat hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. No emissive anywhere.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a stylized diorama of a community - several different kinds of organisms (a tree, a small bird, an insect, a mushroom, a patch of grass) sharing one area. Between them, gentle arrows: a feeding arrow, a competition pair reaching for one food dot, and a flower-pollinator pair. Warm off-white background, muted, no glow. Named nodes: Tree, Bird, Insect, Mushroom, GrassPatch, FeedArrow, CompetitionPair, PollinatorPair. Budget 10-14k.
